data.notes: April 2026 in Amsterdam was anchored by Easter-weekend electronic festivals, a packed King’s Day calendar, and a few major arena and club-tour concerts.

events.title: DGTL Amsterdam 2026
events.summary: DGTL returned to the NDSM-werf for a weekend of electronic music, art and production, with listed names including Dom Dolla, CamelPhat, Jayda G, I Hate Models, Gerd Janson, Luuk van Dijk and Weval live.

events.title: SPIELRAUM Weekender
events.summary: SPIELRAUM’s Easter weekender ran from Saturday night into Monday morning at CLUB RAUM. The RA-listed lineup included Bambounou, Buttechno live, Cio D’Or, Dee Diggs, livwutang, Mama Snake, Rey Colino and Tasha.

events.title: Cosmic Gate: Open To Close Amsterdam
events.summary: Cosmic Gate played an exclusive five-hour open-to-close Amsterdam show at Melkweg OZ on Easter Sunday. The event focused on the duo’s long-running trance and progressive sound.

events.title: Ratherlost Easter Sunday
events.summary: Ratherlost’s Easter Sunday edition at Lofi ran from afternoon into the next morning. Lofi’s listing named Altinbas b2b Efdemin, Oscar Mulero, Skee Mask, Polygonia, mad miran and others.

events.title: Amsterdam Calling 2026
events.summary: Amsterdam Calling returned to Melkweg as a Eurovision-focused live event and party. The programme promised live performances by Eurovision stars plus DJ sets of Eurovision classics.

events.title: We are iT Festival 2026
events.summary: We are iT Festival 2026 took over Thuishaven with a Golden Age of House Music theme. The RA-listed lineup included Jean, ROOG, Erick E, Joost van Bellen, Lucien Foort, Remy Unger and Funkerman.

events.title: Minimal Music Festival 2026
events.summary: The ninth Minimal Music Festival presented four days of hypnotic minimal, contemporary and electronic-leaning performance. The programme included Bang on a Can All-Stars’ Terry Riley 90th Birthday Celebration, Sarathy Korwar, Bendik Giske + Sam Barker, Mohammad Reza Mortazavi, Julianna Barwick and Mary Lattimore.

events.title: ROSALÍA: LUX TOUR 2026
events.summary: ROSALÍA brought her LUX TOUR 2026 to Ziggo Dome for two Amsterdam dates on 22 and 23 April. MOJO described the show around her modern flamenco-inflected pop, reggaeton, hip-hop and R&B sound.

events.title: Krezip
events.summary: Dutch pop band Krezip played Melkweg MAX with support from Tape Toy. Melkweg listed the show as part of Krezip’s 2026 club tour through the Netherlands and Belgium.

events.title: Lofi by Speedy J
events.summary: Lofi hosted a late-night techno session headlined by Speedy J. The venue listing also named Claudio PRC b2b Isabel Soto and Megan Leber for the Club room.

events.title: FYM x Oranjebloesem Kingsday Amsterdam
events.summary: Free Your Mind and Oranjebloesem joined forces for a King’s Day event at RAI Amsterdam from 12:00 to 22:00. RA’s listing included Sara Landry, Reinier Zonneveld live, Maddix, MALUGI, Michel de Hey and Prunk among the lineup.

events.title: Kingsland Amsterdam 2026
events.summary: Kingsland Amsterdam staged its King’s Day edition at the Olympic Stadium on 27 April 2026. The official site listed the date, venue and line-up section for the city’s large-scale orange-day pop and dance celebration.
